content:
zara: Quick heads-up
during onboarding CI run the sample-app auth/backoff tests started failing after the latest typegen regen.
ben: Which job?
zara: CI #9201. Fail snippet: ```
FAIL tests/auth/backoff.spec.ts
  expected 2 retries but got 0
```
tom: Any regendiff details?
publish-checker: regen-diff detected for 'ts-sdk' -> generated/clients/authClient.ts changed. Semver impact: behavioral -> minor. Missing changelog entry blocks publish.
olivia: Root cause appears to be an "example shuffle" in the OpenAPI->typegen step. The generator inferred a retry wrapper when a specific example existed; regen reordered examples, so the inferred wrapper disappeared.
ben: Oof. Fix options: revert the change in go-sdk, update ts-sdk to match, or make sample-app examples explicit. Fastest is to patch sample-app to pass retryPolicy explicitly to keep onboarding green.
zara: Agreed. ben: I'll add a deterministic sort to the typegen example emitter and a regression test to lock hashes. tom: I'll open the sample-app hotfix PR to set retryPolicy explicitly. olivia: I'll draft the changelog entry noting "Align TS SDK retry defaults with Go SDK to restore parity" in case we release the SDK as a minor bump.
publish-checker: publish-checker: regen-diff rerun pending.
ben: PRs: codegen#987 deterministic sort + regen test; sample-app#212 explicit retryPolicy. Triggering regen locally.
zara: If regen stabilizes and we still need behavior change, we'll publish ts-sdk with a minor bump and include the manual changelog text. For now, sample-app patch keeps CI green.
tom: Hotfix merged, onboarding CI rerun triggered.
publish-checker: regen-diff resolved on codegen branch. No blocking regen-diffs remain.
olivia: Follow-ups: add a devex note about avoiding implicit defaults in examples and update changelog auto-picker to surface behavioral changes for manual review. Closing thread once tasks are on the DX board. :sparkles:
